subject: UPDATE THERES MORE...
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
Microsoft has today confirmed that a Limited Edition XBOX 360 will be released to coincide with the launch of RESIDENT EVIL on March 13th.

The bundle will include a red XBOX 360 with 120GB hard drive, a copy of Resident Evil 5, an exclusive Premium Resident Evil 5 theme, and a red wireless controller.  An redeemable code for Super STREET FIGHTER II Turbo Remix HD will also be bundled in with the pack.

The Resident Evil 5 bundle isn't the first themed Xbox 360 release, and follows the launch of a Halo 3 green Xbox 360, and yellow Xbox 360 to coincide with The SIMPSONS movie.

Impressed because i am......ill upload images and prices as soon as i get them :)
